episodes.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
episodes.summary: As high schoolers, Kook Yeon-su and Choi Ung give a documentary crew a peek into their lives. Ten years later, they've gone their separate ways.

episodes.title: 1792 Days of Summer
episodes.summary: Yeon-su and Ung reunite for the first time in five years when she shows up at his door with a proposal to work together on an art project

episodes.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
episodes.summary: Eager to film a follow-up documentary, Kim Ji-ung sets out to persuade Yeon-su and Ung. But getting them to agree proves to be a challenge.

episodes.title: The Boy, or the Girl, We Liked Then
episodes.summary: Yeon-su and Ung's squabbles begin even before the cameras start rolling. Ung refuses to dignify an infuriating plagiarism accusation with a response.

episodes.title: A Secret That Can't Be Told
episodes.summary: Ji-ung recounts how he and Ung became friends in their childhood. Yeon-su wants to apologize to Ung, but can't quite bring herself to do it.

episodes.title: Pride and Prejudice
episodes.summary: Ung wakes up on the morning of the live drawing show with a few gaps in his memory. Watching him at work, Yeon-su sees an unfamiliar side of him

episodes.title: Catch Me If You Can
episodes.summary: Ung and Yeon-su attempt to run away from having to see each other, but wind up in the same place anyway. NJ stands up to her cyberbullies.

episodes.title: Before Sunset
episodes.summary: A forced vacation commences for Yeon-su and Ung when the documentary crew traps them at a mountain retreat. Awkward tensions run high between the pair.

episodes.title: Just Friends
episodes.summary: When she doesn't hear from Ung after their return from the retreat, Yeon-su decides to confront him. He has a disorienting response for her.

episodes.title: Hello, My Soul Mate
episodes.summary: With his mother back in town, Ji-ung stops going home so he can avoid seeing her. Watching NJ and Ung go on a date vexes Yeon-su to no end.

episodes.title: Our Nights Are More Beautiful Than Your Days
episodes.summary: Ahead of the final day of filming, gossip about Ung and NJ causes a stir. Ji-ung receives pointed advice about his documentary edit.

episodes.title: Begin again
episodes.summary: For Ung and Yeon-su, a new beginning is equal parts sweet and clumsy. When NJ bumps into Ji-ung, she invites him out for a drink.

episodes.title: Love Actually
episodes.summary: After soliciting dating advice from a co-worker, Yeon-su acts out of character in front of Ung. Meanwhile, Ji-ung takes some time to himself.

episodes.title: Life Is Beautiful
episodes.summary: Ung asks Yeon-su a question that's difficult for her to answer. As Lee Sol-i deals with an unwanted surprise in her bar, Gu Eun-ho happens to swing by.

episodes.title: Three Idiots
episodes.summary: A noticeably down Ji-ung pours himself into his work instead of going home. Ung waits for Yeon-su to come and see the final night of his art exhibit.

episodes.title: Our Beloved Summer
episodes.summary: Ready to pursue his next dream, Ung sets his sights on studying overseas. When he asks Yeon-su to join him, she has a tough decision to make.
